id: title:eleftheriatrivyzaki:help password managers recognize existing password fields

review.posthog_relevance: Adds accessibility and password manager compatibility support to the TimeSensitiveAuthenticationModal and ChangePassword form.
review.reason: Adds a hidden, screen-reader-only email input and a wrapper div to the TimeSensitiveAuthenticationModal, while also adding a hidden email input to the ChangePassword form.
review.uncertainty: Assessment is limited by the absence of complete surrounding JSX structure and parent component context, preventing full assessment of the wrapper div's impact and potential unrelated changes.
